input-field.name: enableStorefrontValidation
input-field.label: Enable storefront validation
input-field.helpText: Enables backend-powered address validation for storefront address flows.

input-field.name: enableAdminValidation
input-field.label: Enable admin validation
input-field.helpText: Allows administrators to validate addresses from the Administration in later steps.

input-field.name: enableAutomaticStandardization
input-field.label: Enable automatic standardization
input-field.helpText: Allows standardized Smarty address data to be applied after explicit confirmation.

input-field.name: enableGeocoding
input-field.label: Enable geocoding
input-field.helpText: Stores latitude and longitude returned by Smarty when available.

input-field.name: enableLogging
input-field.label: Enable logging
input-field.helpText: Logs backend validation activity without exposing credentials.

input-field.name: smartyAuthId
input-field.label: Smarty Auth ID
input-field.helpText: Backend-only credential. Never expose this value to storefront JavaScript.

input-field.name: smartyWebsiteKey
input-field.label: Smarty Website Key
input-field.helpText: Optional alternative key. Backend services decide how it is used.

input-field.name: smartyAuthToken
input-field.label: Smarty Auth Token
input-field.helpText: Backend-only secret. Never expose this value to storefront JavaScript.

input-field.name: validationAgeThresholdMonths
input-field.label: Validation age threshold in months
input-field.helpText: Addresses older than this threshold should be revalidated in later steps.
